intro: These suggestions are for your review only. Nothing here has been implemented. Choose the ones you want (for example S1, S4, S6) and we will implement only those.

items.title: Add a weighted scoring table for hotels
items.detail: Score each hotel on price, Michelin count within reach, room fit and travel time. Weights are set by you. Shows the top pick clearly.
items.benefit: Turns the ranking into one decision you can check.
items.tradeoff: Needs your weights, and the price and transit columns must be filled first.

items.title: Build a price log for each hotel (manual check on set days)
items.detail: Record official rates for Feb 15–18 and Feb 15–22, 2027 at a fixed time each week, with a link and timestamp. The 'cheapest time to book' is then read from the log.
items.benefit: The only honest way to find the cheapest booking time, since no official history is available.
items.tradeoff: Needs a weekly check; a few months of data is needed before conclusions.

items.title: Verify transit times with RTC Southern Nevada routes
items.detail: For each hotel, record the bus route, boarding stop, and scheduled time to each Michelin restaurant and activity. Only official RTC schedule data is used.
items.benefit: Enables the '1 hour by bus' test the brief asks for.
items.tradeoff: Schedules vary by day and time; results are estimates from published data.

items.title: Pull per-restaurant price ranges from Michelin Guide pages
items.detail: Open each of the 24 restaurant pages on the Michelin Guide site and record price ranges, cuisine and hours exactly as shown.
items.benefit: Gives the 2-adult cost range the brief asks for, from the source Michelin uses.
items.tradeoff: guide.michelin.com could not be retrieved in this session; needs a manual or retried pass.

items.title: Add Downtown hotels so the Esther's Kitchen and SoulBelly cluster is covered
items.detail: Two of the Michelin restaurants sit on S. Main St. Downtown hotels would let that cluster be scored like the Strip.
items.benefit: Fair comparison across the whole Michelin list.

items.title: Choose the activities list first, then re-run the travel-time check
items.detail: Pick the activities (for example Hoover Dam, Red Rock, Valley of Fire, Neon Museum, or others). Then add distance and drive or bus time from each hotel.

items.title: Add a 'last verified' date to every row
items.detail: Show the date each value was checked, so old data is easy to spot.
items.benefit: Makes the verification standard visible on each row.
items.tradeoff: More columns; mobile cards get longer.

items.title: Add an automated link check on each push (GitHub Actions)
items.detail: Run the site checker on every push to catch broken links and empty required sources before the site publishes.
items.benefit: Protects against broken links after future edits.
items.tradeoff: Adds a small workflow file to the repo.

items.title: Add a 'deal breakers' list (bathroom, bed, budget cap, distance cap)
items.detail: Hotels that fail a must-have are moved to a separate section instead of being ranked.
items.benefit: Stops the ranking from including hotels you cannot accept.
items.tradeoff: Needs your input on Q4 and Q7.
